headline: Select all and the arrows sit where they do in Trace+
notes: **Each sequence has a tick box at the top left.** Tick it to select that cut's uses; it works on a folded sequence too.
**The back and forward arrows moved to the bottom bar**, just before Select all.
**Source brings the Source Monitor to the front**, even when that clip is already open in it.
**Selecting a bin shows a Get Trace+ button**: Trace+ scans entire bins and builds Stringout sequences.
